subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SJR33
title: Establishes the right of a parent to choose a school choice option. Provides funding for a school choice option.
headline: SJR 33 did not pass

claims.text: SJR 33 was introduced in the Senate on February 27, 2025.
SJR 33 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
SJR 33 is a proposed change to the Oregon Constitution. It would have gone to voters if passed; it did not pass, so it will not be on your ballot.
